title: sdks: unify auth/retries, improve streaming ergonomics, parity fixes + v1.138.0 bump
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Context and motivation: We need consistent auth and retry semantics across Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs and better streaming ergonomics for client code. This PR centralizes the auth hook, standardizes retry/backoff behavior, and adjusts streaming APIs to provide a single ergonomic surface that matches the new server-side streaming guarantees. This includes parity bug fixes and a coordinated version bump to v1.138.0 across SDKs.

What/overview: single PR touching the three language SDKs with the following highlights: - Extracted a shared auth middleware pattern (AuthProvider) to normalize token refresh + header injection across SDKs. - Unified retry policy: shared configuration (max_attempts, backoff_base_ms, jitter) and transparent idempotency handling for idempotent routes. - Streaming ergonomics: introduce consistent async iterator pattern for streaming responses (Python async generator, TS async iterator, Go channel iterator) and small helpers for line-delimited JSON parsing. - Parity fixes: aligned field names and error shapes for edge cases observed in production (embedding endpoints, conversation delta events). - Version bumps: released as v1.138.0 for python/ts/go after cross-language smoke tests.

Checklist:
- [x] Add AuthProvider implementation and tests for Python/TS/Go
- [x] Implement uniform retry/backoff wiring and tests
- [x] Update streaming client helpers and add examples
- [x] Fix parity bugs discovered in integration tests
- [x] Bump SDK versions and update changelogs
- [x] Run full CI matrix and manual smoke tests

Files changed (high level): 
- sdk/python/redwood_sdk/auth.py: new AuthProvider + tests updated
- sdk/python/redwood_sdk/retries.py: unified retry logic + tests
- sdk/python/redwood_sdk/streaming.py: new async generator wrapper and examples
- sdk/typescript/src/auth.ts: AuthProvider and token-refresh wiring
- sdk/typescript/src/retries.ts: retry strategy with jitter/backoff
- sdk/typescript/src/streaming.ts: async iterator + helper parsers
- sdk/go/redwood/auth.go: AuthProvider interface + implementation
- sdk/go/redwood/retries.go: unified retry strategy
- sdk/go/redwood/streaming.go: channel-based iterator and helpers
- sdk/*/CHANGELOG.md: changelog and version bumps
